submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.118%) at Ag0.57Sb0.43, in the AgSbO3 region. MACE puts AgSbO3 on the hull and MEGNet gives it a 1.78 eV gap, below the 2.4 eV photons. EQE was 0.115% at 1:1 and fell to 0.044% on the Sb-rich side.

rejected.reason: MEGNet predicts a near-metallic gap (0.09 eV), and there was no budget left

consultations.verdict: Support: AgSbO3 (mp-545999) is on hull per MACE and MEGNet HSE gap 1.78 eV < 2.4 eV photon energy, so the Ag:Sb≈1:1 composition should be single-phase absorbing AgSbO3.

Mixed: Ag-rich Ag3SbO4 predicted near-metallic (0.09 eV), arguing against the Ag-rich side; Sb oxide (SbO4-type) gap 1.57 eV absorbs 2.4 eV, so an Sb-rich AgSbO3 + Sb-oxide mixture is a plausible better region to probe than Ag-rich.

Weakly supportive: Ag3SbO4 is only slightly above hull (0.017 eV/atom), so at Ag~0.57 the film should be mostly AgSbO3 with a minor Ag-rich phase; EQE fell on the Sb-rich side (0.044 at 0.26 Ag vs 0.115 at 0.50), so the maximum likely sits at or slightly Ag-rich of 1:1.
